features: 📸 1080P HD VIDEO RECORDING Capture everyday moments, travel memories, outdoor activities and casual videos in 1080P Full HD. The compact G6 Thumb Camera is designed for convenient on-the-go recording without the bulk of a traditional camera.

🔭 130° WIDE-ANGLE LENS & AUTOFOCUS The 130° wide-angle lens provides a broader field of view for travel, outdoor activities, vlogging and everyday recording. AF autofocus helps keep subjects clear and focused while capturing your moments.

🧳 MINI, LIGHTWEIGHT & KEYCHAIN DESIGN Weighing approximately 26g, the G6 is small enough to carry in your pocket, bag or backpack. The built-in attachment point and included keychain make it easy to keep the camera accessible wherever you go.

🌙 LOW-LIGHT RECORDING & AUXILIARY LIGHTING Designed for recording in different environments, the G6 features night-vision/low-light capability and auxiliary lighting to help capture moments when lighting conditions are less than ideal.

🔋 RECHARGEABLE & TYPE-C CHARGING The built-in rechargeable battery makes the camera convenient for portable use. The USB Type-C charging port provides a modern and convenient way to recharge the camera between adventures.

🖥️ TFT LCD SCREEN The built-in TFT LCD screen provides a convenient viewing interface for using the camera and reviewing captured content. Its compact body makes the G6 suitable for travel, everyday use and casual content creation.
